message: よかったよかった
Now then, what was on special today again…….
Is that…….

name: Nanaka
message: 「I think the flour and milk are different」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「I see. Come to think of it, my father's recipes didn't specify where the ingredients came from……」
It's Nanaka and the manager of 『Peace Tanimura Patisserie』.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wasn't there a notebook with phone numbers or memos written down」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Unfortunately, it looks very likely that everything was thrown out」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on……」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Still, I'll look for them first. If I can't find anything, I'll just have to test them one by one」
Looks like they've completely made up. Good. Good.

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Today's featured special is Matsusaka beef!」

name: Synn
message: 「I couldn't afford that even on sale! More importantly, how did you know I was thinking about today's specials!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because we're childhood friends」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, fair enough」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Hello, Student Council President」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, it's been a while」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Thank you very much for everything back then」

name: Synn
message: 「Not at all. I just wanted to help make KiraFes a success」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Someday, I'll repay you by making sweets that rival my father's」

name: Synn
message: 「Best of luck」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Yes!」
Yeah. He looks way livelier than before.
His steps as he walks away are firm, too. Probably because he has a goal now.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wonder if he'll manage it while I'm still alive」

name: Synn
message: 「You say that, but you're actually looking forward to it, aren't you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Childhood friends really do know everything, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, we are childhood friends」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well... not everything, though」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nothing!」
